domains.name: Human-Centered AI Design & Prototyping
domains.description: Human-centered AI design and prototyping: requirements, rapid prototyping, UI/UX, user feedback, and stakeholder alignment.

domains.name: Data Handling, APIs & AI Infrastructure
domains.description: Data handling, APIs, and AI infrastructure: data sources, databases, data-quality practice, cloud deployment, and performance monitoring.

domains.description: AI security, compliance, and ethics: bias/ethics, data security, privacy law, responsible-AI policy, and content monitoring.

competencies.statement: The learner can explain the capabilities and limitations of generative AI models (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini).
competencies.description: Describes what current LLMs can/can't do and why.

competencies.statement: The learner can craft effective prompts for different AI tasks (text generation, summarization, image creation).
competencies.description: Writes a task-appropriate prompt that produces the intended output.

competencies.statement: The learner can apply advanced prompt chaining and few-shot learning techniques.
competencies.description: Structures multi-step or exemplar-based prompts for a complex task.

competencies.statement: The learner can evaluate AI responses for accuracy, relevance, and bias.
competencies.description: Judges an AI output and identifies errors or bias.

competencies.statement: The learner can use AI APIs and fine-tune models via platforms such as the OpenAI or Claude APIs.
competencies.description: Calls an LLM API correctly and knows when/how fine-tuning applies.

competencies.statement: The learner can build applications using no-code/low-code tools (e.g., Airtable, Make.com, n8n, Zapier, Softr).
competencies.description: Assembles a working app/automation in a no-code platform.

competencies.statement: The learner can design and automate workflows using AI and logic-based automation.
competencies.description: Models a workflow with branching logic and an AI step.

competencies.statement: The learner can configure API integrations and webhooks to connect different tools.
competencies.description: Wires two tools together via API/webhook correctly.

competencies.statement: The learner can deploy an AI-powered chatbot solution for business use.
competencies.description: Stands up and configures a functional business chatbot.

competencies.statement: The learner can build AI-driven business workflows for data processing, reporting, and decision-making.
competencies.description: Designs a workflow that turns inputs into a decision/report.

competencies.statement: The learner can implement document automation using AI (e.g., contract generation, summarization).
competencies.description: Automates a document task end to end.

competencies.statement: The learner can design intelligent email and customer-service automation systems.
competencies.description: Builds an automated triage/response flow.

competencies.statement: The learner can optimize business processes by integrating AI into existing operations.
competencies.description: Identifies where AI improves a process and integrates it.

competencies.statement: The learner can troubleshoot automation failures and refine workflows to improve performance.
competencies.description: Diagnoses a broken automation and fixes it.

competencies.statement: The learner can work with clients to identify AI automation needs and requirements.
competencies.description: Elicits and documents requirements from a stakeholder.

competencies.statement: The learner can conduct rapid prototyping and iteration using AI tools.
competencies.description: Produces and iterates a prototype quickly.

competencies.statement: The learner can apply UI/UX best practices to AI-powered solutions.
competencies.description: Designs a usable interface for an AI feature.

competencies.statement: The learner can collect user feedback to refine and improve AI-powered prototypes.
competencies.description: Gathers and acts on user feedback.

competencies.statement: The learner can collaborate with stakeholders to align AI solutions with business goals.
competencies.description: Keeps a solution aligned to stated goals.

competencies.statement: The learner can work with structured and unstructured data sources for AI-powered automation.
competencies.description: Prepares varied data sources for use in a workflow.

competencies.statement: The learner can develop AI workflows that interact with databases (SQL, NoSQL, Airtable).
competencies.description: Reads/writes data from a database in a workflow.

competencies.statement: The learner can apply data validation, transformation, and storage best practices.
competencies.description: Validates and transforms data correctly before storage.

competencies.statement: The learner can configure and deploy AI models using cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP).
competencies.description: Deploys a model/endpoint on a cloud platform.

competencies.statement: The learner can monitor AI performance and optimize models for accuracy and efficiency.
competencies.description: Tracks performance metrics and tunes for improvement.

competencies.statement: The learner can ensure AI automation follows ethical AI principles and mitigates bias.
competencies.description: Applies fairness/ethics checks to an automation.

competencies.statement: The learner can implement data-security best practices in AI workflows.
competencies.description: Protects secrets/PII and secures data flow.

competencies.statement: The learner can apply data-privacy laws (GDPR, CCPA) to AI workflows.
competencies.description: Identifies compliant data handling in a scenario.

competencies.statement: The learner can develop responsible-AI policies for automation and decision-making.
competencies.description: Drafts a usable responsible-AI guideline.

competencies.statement: The learner can monitor AI-generated content to avoid misinformation and compliance risks.
competencies.description: Reviews AI output for misinformation/compliance issues.
